definition: Samadhi governed by the signless side of the emptiness / signless / wishless family.
notes: Keep this compound tied to animitta as signless rather than flattening it into formlessness or blank trance-language. Aligned in the 2026-11-09 Wave 13 audit with the samādhi ruling (`unification of mind`, compact `unification` in compounds) so that the three unification records read as one family: `emptiness unification`, `signless unification`, `wishless unification`. The cetosamādhi records keep the full `unification of mind`.

example_phrases.pali: Suññato samādhi, animitto samādhi, appaṇihito samādhi
example_phrases.translation: emptiness unification, signless unification, wishless unification
example_phrases.notes: SN 43.4 names the three together as the path to the unconditioned; DN 33 lists them among the threes. Cited in the 2026-11-09 Wave 12 emptiness-cluster citation pass.
